title: lastrea mexicana
intro: Lastrea mexicana, commonly known as Mexican Lady Fern, is a species of fern in the family Blechnaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, respiratory issues, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
